label: Does a favouring standard or 'because of goodness' separate personal from impersonal finality?
summary: See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md sections 65-69 (#2145 Lane 2b). Verified results: 652f9917 (content-fixed favouring laws: an outcome-independent content with asymmetric favouring does not select whatever outcome occurs in a scope with a contingent outcome, the #742 core on choice cells; the outcome re-description that meets the determination standard does so only by being outcome-dependent; good-bounded favouring selects nothing between tied outcomes or when every outcome is bettered), b5fe7a87 (controlled dependence laws: fixed or control-factoring profiles depend on nothing; tracking characterization; if goodness factors through the held feature no aligned profile depends on it; two profiles tracking one feature agree; the plan standard reads only Requirement, so dependence on it supplies neither ApprehendsAsGood nor SpecifiesGiving), da0125fd (matched table of chance, proxy, D-nature, determined will, good-general nature and rational exercise over four scenarios: parity on the actual contrasts among non-chance profiles, no favouring explanation of c over the tied d, reversal separates proxy from D-tracking, goodness variation at fixed D separates D-tracking from good-tracking on both sides; sense-mixing control for BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS 1 and 2). New disambiguation BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS (8430c7dc). Findings: the favouring standard discriminates where determination did not, but gives parity between rational exercise and every non-chance impersonal profile at the actual standard; producing a beneficial arrangement, producing it for its end D, and producing it because of its goodness are typed apart; a noncognitive D-directed nature meets the end-content reading and fails the controlled goodness reading, as a determined will does; the goodness reading needs counterpossible variation; none of the dependence readings supplies the apprehended plan of 4be0f774.
blocker: Not blocked for the assigned formal questions. The personal/impersonal line is not crossed by any typed test: rational exercise and a good-general noncognitive profile are the same function. Further discrimination needs (1) the content-generality bridge (is a favouring that is a function of the betterness of arbitrary, including unrealized, candidate contents a cognitive relation?), (2) warrant that non-coincidence of the origin's favouring with goodness (E4) belongs to the explanandum of original finality, or (3) a decision on the admissibility of counterpossible goodness variation.

current_assessment.scope: Contrastive favouring with outcome-independent content; three readings of 'produced because of its goodness'; matched personal and impersonal profiles
current_assessment.assessment: Under content-fixed favouring (the cell-carrier analogue of SELECTING_AN_OUTCOME_1), which a re-description of the outcome fails, rational exercise, a D-directed generative nature, a good-general nature, a determined will and a physical proxy explain the same actual contrasts and none explains the selection of one of two tied D-realizations, which remains a contingent exercise on both sides; chance explains nothing. Dependence on the end D separates the proxy; dependence on goodness at fixed D separates good-general from determined-to-one profiles, personal and impersonal alike, and requires counterpossible goodness variation. Original finality (beneficial, the origin's own favouring, dependent on D) requires the end-content reading only; it requires the goodness reading only with a non-coincidence explanandum (E4), and the apprehended plan of 4be0f774 only with E4 and a content-generality bridge, neither established. No unconditional ranking.
current_assessment.next_test: Define content-general favouring (a function of the betterness of arbitrary candidate contents) and test whether it is a cognitive relation; assess warrant for E4 by contrasting derivative natural finality with an origin's favouring of other natures' goods; decide whether counterpossible goodness variation is admissible; Lane 1 hook on content determination as limitation.
current_assessment.evidence: Proposed delivery on branch research/impersonal-finality; three results with focused Lean build; independent semantic challenge pending.
current_assessment.supersedes: None. It answers the selection-standard next test of attempt d6bcce8a and refines the because-of-goodness question of will-versus-chance.md section C without revising their judgments.
